style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun, clear shallow water
motion_rule: he holds his spot over the sunken stall and the whole market flies at him: crates, ropes, buoys and nets rush past the lens in EVERY beat, driven by a current that reverses at 1.90, 3.60, 5.55 and 7.45; the eel hauls papers through the lens and pale fish sink past him in EVERY beat; his gold gills pump and he works fins, tail and mouth in EVERY beat; he fills half the frame height; new shot size every beat; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump golden carp upright on his tail, thick lips, heavy jowls, two huge gilded gill covers pumping like bellows
second_characters: ONE lean eel broker in a silk tie, always within a fin of the lens, hauling blank papers across the frame every beat; A SWARM of pale fish with dull gills sinking behind him; from 6.85 two preening fancy fish in pearls and long veil fins sweep through the frame
props: ONE blank paper sheet the sinking fish carry, never his; furry mic bottom right
environment: a noon bright shallow lagoon over a sunken market: sun shafts to the sand, packed crates and hanging nets

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, flat and smug, even 4.7 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-3.60 one breath, short breath at 3.60, 3.60-6.85 one breath; after 6.85 no words, only his whistle and sfx
audio.pronunciation: go-DA-mi, NO-si-te, DEN-ghi, AK-tsi-i, ZHDYO-te, CHU-da, vlo-ZHIL, ZHAB-ry, TO-ne-te
audio.lip_sync: his mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over; at 8.05 his lips purse into a long two-note wolf whistle
audio.sfx: water surge, bubbles bursting, paper rustling, a gill bellows wheeze, a loud wolf whistle at 8.05
